title: Ocean colour virtual stores
description: Byte-reference indexes of ocean colour products over Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF copies of the original netCDF files: ESA Ocean Colour CCI v6.0 merged-sensor chlorophyll-a and its log10 bias and RMSD, geographic 4 km. Each dataset is published as a GDAL multidimensional VRT, kerchunk Parquet, an Icechunk repository with virtual references, a flat Parquet refs store and a STAC collection. Drafts.
